pirates_cove.name: Pirate's Cove
pirates_cove.description: A captain's desk, warm brass and tasteful nautical details.
pirates_cove.palette_names: dark walnut, warm brass and deep teal
pirates_cove.materials: dark timber furniture, aged brass accents and restrained rope trim
pirates_cove.decorations: small nautical artwork and treasure-inspired storage boxes
pirates_cove.shelving: dark timber freestanding shelving with brass details
pirates_cove.lighting: warm ship-lantern-style electric lamps with believable light falloff
pirates_cove.equipment: modern black gaming equipment with subtle brass-colored details
pirates_cove.constraints: keep nautical styling tasteful and equipment modern and usable
pirates_cove.negative_constraints: no ship reconstruction, open flames, new portholes or altered openings

cat_kingdom.name: Cat Kingdom
cat_kingdom.description: Cozy textiles, soft pastels and playful feline accessories.
cat_kingdom.palette_names: dusty pink, lavender and warm cream
cat_kingdom.materials: cozy upholstered furniture, pale timber and soft textiles
cat_kingdom.lighting: soft pastel accent light when colored lighting is enabled
cat_kingdom.equipment: modern pastel gaming hardware with subtle feline-inspired detailing
cat_kingdom.constraints: use practical furniture with restrained cat-themed details, not cartoon-scale objects
cat_kingdom.negative_constraints: no giant cats, animal-shaped architecture or altered windows and doors

underwater_realm.name: Underwater Realm
underwater_realm.description: Ocean tones, sculptural lamps and dry, aquatic-inspired decor.
underwater_realm.palette_names: ocean blue, turquoise and pale sea-glass green
underwater_realm.materials: matte ocean-blue finishes, turquoise details and subtly aquatic textured furniture
underwater_realm.lighting: electric jellyfish-shaped lamps and ocean-blue or turquoise accents when enabled
underwater_realm.equipment: contemporary gaming hardware with restrained aquatic color accents
underwater_realm.constraints: all aquatic effects are dry decorative objects or electric light; retain an ordinary habitable room
underwater_realm.negative_constraints: no actual water, flooding, aquarium walls, submerged equipment or wet electrical installations

cyberpunk_neon.name: Cyberpunk Neon
cyberpunk_neon.description: Dark surfaces, cyan and violet accents, clean high-tech hardware.
cyberpunk_neon.materials: dark matte furniture and brushed metal details
cyberpunk_neon.decorations: small futuristic decorative panels on freestanding supports and neon-style accessories
cyberpunk_neon.lighting: controlled purple and cyan accent lighting when colored lighting is enabled
cyberpunk_neon.equipment: clean modern high-tech hardware with realistic screens and supported monitor arms
cyberpunk_neon.constraints: retain readable realistic materials and avoid excessive bloom
cyberpunk_neon.negative_constraints: no futuristic replacement architecture, floating equipment or room-wide neon haze

enchanted_forest.name: Enchanted Forest
enchanted_forest.description: Natural wood, greenery and a restrained touch of fantasy.
enchanted_forest.palette_names: forest green, natural timber and soft amber
enchanted_forest.materials: natural wood furniture, soft organic forms and textured upholstery
enchanted_forest.decorations: small potted greenery and forest-inspired ornaments
enchanted_forest.shelving: natural timber freestanding shelving with organic forms
enchanted_forest.lighting: electric mushroom-inspired lamps and warm low-voltage fairy lights
enchanted_forest.equipment: modern functional gaming hardware with warm timber-colored accessories
enchanted_forest.constraints: fantasy styling comes from furniture and accessories inside the existing room
enchanted_forest.negative_constraints: no indoor forest replacing walls, growing structural trees or altered ceiling and flooring

minimalist_luxury.name: Minimalist Luxury
minimalist_luxury.description: Premium materials, clean lines and a quietly refined setup.
minimalist_luxury.palette_names: warm stone, taupe and muted champagne
minimalist_luxury.materials: refined timber, premium matte finishes and elegant upholstered furniture
minimalist_luxury.lighting: understated warm ambient light with realistic shadows
minimalist_luxury.equipment: elegant black or neutral equipment and carefully concealed cables
minimalist_luxury.constraints: keep the setup restrained, uncluttered and practical
minimalist_luxury.negative_constraints: no structural renovation, replacement flooring or luxury-room reconstruction
